title: local_state
summary: Current Benilla local_state.rs centralizes portable persistence paths and atomic writes for configuration, macros, bindings, remembered account, camera, screenshots and addon/Lua state. Its ui_saved.rs is specifically the host seam for Lua RegisterForSave globals and VARIABLES_LOADED ordering. MSUI uses its established configuration architecture instead: ClientConfig for machine wiring, GameSettings/SettingsStore with MSUI_SETTINGS_PATH for player preferences and remembered account/character, and dedicated macro/binding stores. Addon and SavedVariables residents remain correctly absent with their missing Lua consumer; no disconnected Lua persistence layer belongs in the desktop client. The observable desktop contract is that enabled settings persist; Remember Account Name now does so while never storing the password.

openItems.text: The login screen's Remember Account Name checkbox updated only ClientConfig in memory and did not persist the account name across launches.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: Added GameSettings.SavedAccountName. Login initialization prefers that saved value, successful manual submit writes or clears it according to the checkbox and saves SettingsStore, and a clinical disk round-trip proves persistence. Passwords are not serialized.
